MHLW/PMDA and MFDS simply have not yet published a November list (checked, confirmed absent, not an EGRESS_BLOCKED case).

Resolved with `git fetch` + `git merge --ff-only origin/main` before any edits were made this run; no data was lost or at risk -- the Nov 11-13 commits were always present on origin/main, just not yet merged into the local branch ref. Confirmed HEAD now matches origin/main exactly before proceeding.
